text: U3 receipt: commit 205e07d on branch stp-upstream in ~/code/scala/reframe4s-stp (unpushed). API: NumericalInversion.invert(pull: DenseMap[T,S,D,R], lattice: Grid[S,D] (persistent), settings: InversionSettings.create(maximumIterations=100, tolerance=1e-8, divergenceRatio=4), gates: InversionGates.create(minimumCoverage, maximumResidual, p99Residual, interiorMargin), revision): Either[InversionError, NumericalInverse[S,T,D](estimate: InverseEstimate, samples: DenseMap, evidence: DenseInverseEvidence)]; InversePointStatus {Converged, MaxIterations, Diverged, OutsideCoverage}; evidence = domainMask, coveredFraction, statusCounts, interiorStatusCounts, forward/reverse ResidualSummary(mean, p99, max, n), BoundaryUse(policy, points), maximumIterationsUsed, statusAt; InversionGateFailure {CoverageBelowMinimum, MaximumResidualExceeded(dir), P99ResidualExceeded(dir), NoResidualSamples(dir), InteriorDivergence}; InversionError.GatesFailed(failures, evidence). Forward = |pull(push(x))-x| on S domain; Reverse = |push(pull(y))-y| on pull lattice. Tests: reframe4s-fieldJVM/test 36/36, reframe4s-fieldJS/test 36/36 (NumericalInversionSuite 7). Analytic sinusoid a*w=0.4: worst inverse error 5.1e-3 vs bound 8.3e-3, forward max 9.7e-11, reverse max 2.3e-2. Caveats: plain (undamped) fixed-point, so maps with |Du|>=1 diverge by design; domain excludes Diverged points; native invwarp/ANTs InverseWarp parity is P6.02 (needs fixtures).
